C0068.title: JD.com sends SMS warning users not to use third-party price comparison tools or plugins
C0068.summary: In June 2024, some users received SMS messages from JD.com stating that their accounts might have been maliciously used, advising them not to use any third-party price comparison tools or plugins and recommending password changes, otherwise accounts suspected of being exploited would face ongoing restrictions.
